dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Visible 'O' and 'C' shaped structures on the posterior flank exhibit jagged, high-contrast light-gray perimeters that transition sharply into dark, low-intensity interior centers.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Low density of solid, small-scale high-intensity pixel clusters scattered between the larger annuli, primarily localized in the mid-body transition zone.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the three largest ring structures on the posterior lateral region form an obtuse triangle, with the longest side oriented longitudinally along the animal's dorsal-lateral plane.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of a distinct labyrinthine or map-like network of interconnected light-gray filaments on the upper posterior dorsal region that do not form fully closed loops.
